title: Weekly remote-jobs newsletter on beehiiv, sponsor-funded

source.text: A weekly newsletter of remote jobs on beehiiv, free for readers, paid by sponsors. Launch country US, budget $500, 6 hours a week, goal side income, no special edge. Just go: do not ask questions. Use the slug remote-jobs-newsletter.

problem: Job seekers want remote roles, which are scarce and scattered across many boards.
customer: US job seekers looking for fully remote roles (readers); employers and brands targeting them (sponsors)
solution: A free weekly email on beehiiv listing curated remote jobs, paid for by sponsors.
assumptions: No questions asked (user said just go); profile taken from the input.
Revenue = beehiiv Ad Network plus direct sponsors; no paid tier for readers.
Founder has no audience, list or sponsor contacts today (no special edge).
Jobs are hand-picked and linked out, not scraped from LinkedIn or Indeed.
Side-income target used for sizing: USD 500 per month.
